The '''Kenobi family''' included the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's mother/Legends|mother]], and his [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's father/Legends|father]]. During his [[Jedi training/Legends|apprenticeship]] to Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], Obi-Wan Kenobi experienced visions of a brother of his called [[Owen (Kenobi)|Owen]]. However, it turned out that those visions were in fact of [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], a man whom Kenobi would not meet before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
